value.description: The controlled selected value of the toggle group.

default-value.description:
The initial selected value of the toggle group when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected value of the toggle group.

multiple.description: Whether to allow multiple toggles to be selected.

orientation.description: The orientation of the toggle group.

loop-focus.description: Whether to loop focus inside the toggle group.

roving-focus.description: Whether to use roving tab index to manage focus.

deselectable.description:
Whether the toggle group allows empty selection.
**Note:** This is ignored if `multiple` is `true`.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

valuechange.description: Fired when the toggle is clicked.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the toggle. Useful for composition.

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.
